aiMetadata.description: Creates a new record in a chosen Knack object (table), with field values supplied as key-value data keyed by Knack field IDs. Use when adding a new row to a Knack database. Not idempotent: each call inserts another record, and a duplicate unique value returns a conflict error.

delete_record.name: delete_record
delete_record.description: Deletes an existing record from a table.

apiKey.description: Your Knack API Key available in the Settings section of the Builder.

applicationId.description: Your Application ID available in the Settings section of the Builder.

recordId.description: The ID of the record to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a single record from a chosen Knack object (table), identified by its record ID. Use when removing a known row. Requires a valid record ID; a missing ID returns a not-found error. Not idempotent: the record is removed on the first successful call and repeating it fails.

fieldValue.description: The value to search for in the specified field.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single record in a chosen Knack object (table) by matching one field against a value (exact "is" match), returning the first match or a not-found result. Use to find a record by a known field value rather than its record ID. Read-only and idempotent.

apiKey.description: Your Knack API Key available in the Settings section of the Builder.

recordId.description: The ID of the record to update.

apiKey.description: Your Knack API Key available in the Settings section of the Builder.

applicationId.description: Your Application ID available in the Settings section of the Builder.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing record in a chosen Knack object (table), identified by its record ID, applying the supplied field values keyed by Knack field IDs. Use when modifying a known row. Requires a valid record ID; a missing ID returns a not-found error. Idempotent: re-applying the same field values to the same record yields the same result.
